name: Cheech & Chong - 1g Cart - Twisted Lime (H)
description:
Zesty, sharp, and refreshingly smooth. The Cheech & Chong Twisted Lime cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Twisted Lime delivers a bright citrus punch: tangy lime up front with a sweet, sugary twist and a clean, crisp finish. Blended with a hybrid terpene profile for a balanced, easygoing feel — lively enough for daytime, smooth enough to ride into the evening.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Twisted Lime flavor — tangy lime with a sweet, crisp finish
Hybrid terpene blend — balanced and easygoing, great any time of day
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Bright flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Cheech & Chong Twisted Lime is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
